A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ReCARE study, with 27 readable pages including Appendices A–O. Pages 2–27 have identical text and rendered content; first-page differences are confined to the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original ReCARE experiments on nudity, Van Gogh style, and tench unlearning, including numerical comparisons, ablations, and additional appendix evaluations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main comparisons in Table 1 and multi-concept preservation evaluations in Appendix N.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain identical CARE-set construction, global clustering, intra-cluster refinement, textual inversion, and retain/erase objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same unlearning tasks and data, including I2P, COCO-30K, other-artist preservation in Appendix J, and multiple benign concepts in Appendix N.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Table 1 and the appendix comparisons, including AC for Van Gogh and SalUn/EraseDiff for tench. No comparison method is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, sample counts, classifiers, attack configurations, generation settings, and prompt construction remain identical in Section 5.1 and Appendices B–D, K, M, and N.

E4.justification: The refinement and cluster-count ablations, encoder comparison, hyperparameter and vocabulary analyses, other-artist examples, and multi-concept tests are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Seed descriptions in Appendix D and statistical reporting throughout are identical. No repeated-run summaries, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 reports ReCARE RATIO values of 0.76, 0.81, and 0.85 for nudity, Van Gogh, and tench respectively in both versions; appendix results also remain identical.

T1.justification: The CARE-score definition, mathematical formulation of CARE-set refinement and training losses, and Appendix M's RATIO derivation are unchanged. No formal assumptions, proofs, or mathematical corrections are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: identifying CARE suppression, introducing the CARE score, and proposing ReCARE to balance robust erasure, utility, and benign-concept preservation.

C2.justification: Explanations of concept entanglement, interpretations of robustness–preservation trade-offs and encoder behavior, and claims about multi-concept generalization are identical. No substantive limitation or qualification is added.

D1.justification: Implementation settings in Appendix C, computational costs, hardware information, prompt examples, reproducibility statements, and the code-access link are unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list, background discussion, and related-work positioning in Appendix E are identical. No cited work or novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin text changes from v1 dated 23 Jun 2026 to v2 dated 25 Aug 2026, and PDF title metadata changes capitalization to emphasize 'Associated REtained'. Manuscript wording and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes font and shifts slightly. All figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layout remain identical, including the appendices.

improvement.justification: v2 changes only bibliographic metadata and the arXiv stamp's text and appearance. The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information are identical throughout the paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
